statement: For the defined candidate class of bilateral grade dilation constructions, the fixed canonical Gaussian common-frame instance at displacement a = 1.5 remains open (FIXED_GAUSSIAN_COMMON_FRAME_INSTANCE_OPEN) pending fully certified interval exclusion of zero in CLM-CT-027. Whole-class closure for general non-canonical or untuned window families remains an open classification (BILATERAL_GRADE_ROUTE_CLASS_CLOSURE_OPEN).

hypotheses: Fixed canonical Gaussian window W(t) = 1/sqrt(2pi) exp(-t^2/2) at a = 1.5
